subject: POC results and a quick reference ask
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@mintco.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@mintco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC results and a quick reference ask

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for the time and collaboration this month — the POC wrapped last week and the results look promising. Quick recap (attached PDF has full details):

- Query latency: median 380ms (20% improvement over your baseline)
- Cost per 1k tokens: ~$0.85 (after batching and KV cache)
- Throughput: sustained 120 requests/min under the test load with 95th pct latency at 720ms
- Accuracy (NDCG-like rerank eval): +11 points on the sampled eval set

You hit the primary goals we discussed: latency <500ms and holding quality above your production thresholds. Given how tightly the POC aligned with your operational profile, we wanted to ask one small favor: would MintCo be open to a short customer quote and a 15-minute reference call for our sales collateral?

Suggested asks:
- A 1–2 sentence blurb we can use on a case study page (metrics + business impact)
- Optional 15-minute call next week for a quick soundbite and a couple of clarifying questions (we can handle scheduling)

If you’re comfortable, I can send a one-line template to make the blurb quick. We’d only publish with your sign-off.

Attachments: mintco_poc_results_v2.pdf, redwood_one_pager.pdf

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene@redwoodinference.com
phone: (415) 555-0123

--
Note: We’ll respect any internal approval flow and can anonymize metrics if needed for public materials.

From: Samir Desai <samir@mintco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@mintco.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC results and a quick reference ask

Irene —

Great summary and thanks for sending the PDF. The team is really happy with the latency improvements and the cost profile. The throughput numbers also look good for our expected traffic shape.

We’re comfortable providing a short blurb and doing a 15-minute call. Two quick notes:
- We’ll need the blurb to highlight the business outcome (reduced page latency -> better conversion) rather than raw token costs in public-facing material.
- Legal will want a short review (standard for external quotes).

I can put together a one-line blurb tomorrow and loop Legal if needed. Available windows for the call: Mon 5/20 between 10–11am PT or Tue 5/21 2–3pm PT.

Best,
Samir Desai
Head of Search & Recommendations | MintCo
samir@mintco.com

To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC results and a quick reference ask

Nice work team — great outcome. Two quick asks from GTM side:

1) Irene / Samir: I can draft a 1-line blurb and a couple of suggested quote variations we can send to Legal. Having options (short and slightly longer) usually speeds approvals.
2) Ben: can you prepare a 30–45s clip of the results for the internal sales playbook (screen recording + callout bullets)? No need to edit heavily — raw is fine.

Irene, do you want me to send the suggested copy directly to Samir or would you prefer to send it from your mailbox? If Samir picks Mon 10–11am PT that works for us; I’ll hold that slot on the calendar unless he confirms a different time.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
